camel_example: aliyun dataworks-public CreateDataset --region cn-hangzhou --StorageType OSS --InitVersion '{"MountPath":"/mnt/data","Comment":"Initial_Version","ImportInfo":{"key":"example-string"},"Url":"oss://test-oss-bucket/test_dir/"}' --ProjectId 12345 --Name test_oss_dataset
description_en: Creates a dataset. You can create a dataset only in a workspace that you have joined. Only DataWorks datasets are supported. The maximum number of datasets per tenant is 2000
description_zh:
创建数据集，仅支持在用户已加入的工作空间创建数据集
且当前仅支持创建DataWorks数据集，单租户下限制数据集最大数量为2000
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-dataset --project-id 12345 --name test_oss_dataset --storage-type OSS --init-version '{"MountPath":"/mnt/data","Comment":"Initial_Version","ImportInfo":{"key":"example-string"},"Url":"oss://test-oss-bucket/test_dir/"}' --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDataset

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The origin of the dataset. Only DataWorks is supported
parameters.help_zh: 数据集来源，当前仅支持DataWorks
parameters.name: origin

parameters.help_en: The name of the dataset. The value must be a non-empty string that is up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 数据集名称，非空字符串，长度不超过128
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the dataset. The value can be up to 1024 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 数据集描述,长度不超过1024
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en:
The data type. Valid values:
COMMON: general-purpose (default).
PIC: image.
TEXT: text.
TABLE: table.
VIDEO: video.
AUDIO: audio.
INDEX: index
parameters.help_zh:
数据类型，取值有
COMMON 通用（默认）
PIC 图片
TEXT 文本
TABLE 表格
VIDEO 视频
AUDIO 音频
INDEX 索引
parameters.name: data_type

parameters.help_en:
The storage type. Valid values:
OSS: Object Storage Service.
NAS: general-purpose NAS file storage.
EXTREMENAS: extreme NAS file storage.
DLF_LANCE: Data Lake Formation
parameters.help_zh:
存储类型，当前支持的取值有
OSS  对象存储
NAS  通用型NAS文件存储
EXTREMENAS  极速型NAS文件存储
DLF_LANCE  数据湖构建
parameters.name: storage_type

fields.help_en: The description. The value can be up to 1024 characters in length
fields.name: comment

fields.help_en:
The storage import configuration of the dataset. The required configuration varies depending on the storage type.
<details>
<summary>NAS</summary>
The values can be obtained from the response of the File Storage NAS API DescribeFileSystems operation.

```JSON
{
  "fileSystemId": "3b6XXX89c9", // File system ID
  "fileSystemStorageType": "Performance", // Storage specification of the file system
  "vpcId": "vpc-uf66oxxxrqge1t2gson7s" // VPC ID of the mount target
}
```

</details>
fields.help_zh:
数据集的存储导入配置, 对于不同存储类型，需要的配置信息不同
<details>
<summary>NAS</summary>
取值可参考文件存储 API DescribeFileSystems 的返回信息

```JSON
{
  "fileSystemId": "3b6XXX89c9", // 文件系统ID
  "fileSystemStorageType": "Performance", // 文件系统的存储规格
  "vpcId": "vpc-uf66oxxxrqge1t2gson7s" // 挂载点的VPC ID
}
```

</details>
fields.name: import_info

fields.help_en: The mount path. The value must start with /mnt/. Default value: /mnt/data
fields.help_zh: 挂载路径，需要以/mnt/开头，默认为/mnt/data
fields.name: mount_path
